title: Kerekes Handshake Claim Schema
description: Defines the structure for forensic professional claims and evidence mapping.

claim_id.description: Unique slug for the claim (e.g., budget_audit_2011).

domain.description: The specific system category (Human, Civic, Physical, Ecological).

description.description: Narrative summary of the diagnosis and intervention, including citation markers.

evidence.description: List of absolute URLs to primary source artifacts.

outcome.description: The verifiable forensic result or systemic impact of the intervention.
